text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. This photo really brings back
memories~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When I won a race, my Trainer took this
photo...
And this one was taken at the main gate
during the Fan Appreciation Festival!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's a great smile, Spe-chan~.
I might have more photos taken off-campus,
though~... Ah, like this one.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aren't these new VR goggles so cool?
Trainer-chan took
a picture of me at the exhibition, and
their specs were so top-notch it got me
super hyped~

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the two of you, I'm not in the
habit of taking photos, so
the only ones I might have... are from
training, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer always films them for me so I
can check my form.
No matter the time, every single day...
I'm truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're so right! They're really
looking out for us...
That's why it makes me feel like,
"Alright, I'm gonna give it my all!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It would be nice... if we could do
something for them once in a while.
A way to give back, or say thank you.
Something—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Then let's do it right now!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Devote everything to the person closest to
that Umamusume!
Fate is whispering it, too! In other
words—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"It's the 'Trainer Appreciation Festival'!
Let's put together a live performance
ourselves
and show it to Trainer! With a brand-new
song, of course!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"A live performance for Trainer-san...!
Wow, that sounds lovely!
A new song, huh~ Making up the dance and
everything together sounds so fun!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Then, why not make the outfits too while
we're at it? I'll gather info from past
live performance archives. Heehee, I've
got a feeling this is gonna be fun~."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I agree as well.
Let's search for a venue that Trainer
would be happy with, too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
All right, that settles it! First up, a
strategy meeting!
Let's put everything we've got into the
Trainer Appreciation Festival!!!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"The dance routine for the new live
concert, right?
—Very well, let us begin."

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"............
—Hmph! Hyaaaaaah!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~, so that's Taiho-chan's dance?
It's pretty cool! Kinda intense, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
These are the fundamental strikes of mixed
martial arts.
They engage the entire body, so they can
be applied to dancing as well.
Furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"It serves as good training.
To synchronize everyone's movements,
repetitive practice is essential."

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Let us strive for synchronized movements
through repetitive discipline.
Such training directly translates into
dance—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...True. But Taiho, a straight punch is
done... like this.
Keep your focus on not dropping your
fist."

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
—!
Yes, I will devote myself to improvement,
Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Channeling strength and focus throughout
your entire body.
So that is the path... to becoming the
"strongest."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
And there they go, starting their training
talk.
He~y, you two, we're talking about dancing
right now~

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... but even if you tell me to just
start dancing, that's kinda tough.
I need to solidify the image a bit more...
Hmmm...

"......Excuse me.
Would it be all right if I used that
equipment over there now?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Efforia! Right, won't you
dance with us too?!
The ultimate dance to express our
gratitude to Trainer! Right this instant!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Talk about an unreasonable demand!?
Epi-san, you're always like this, but this
is way too sudden~!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
"Understood. A dance to express your
gratitude to the Trainer, correct?
—As you command, Epiphaneia-san."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...! Incredible...!
You look just like a princess at a ball!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! That's awesome, way to go, Effie!
Haha, that's so good you could use it in a
live performance right now!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Full-body exercise makes for a great
warm-up.

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
If it is beneficial to the race, I will
comply.
Devoting myself to victory—that is my—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Because it is destiny.
Because it's destiny!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I knew it! I just knew!
Alright, next let's dance together!
Fiercely, so our gratitude gets through
even more!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Both of you this time!?
Stop, pleeeeease stooooop!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I feel like I've got the image down!
Now I just need to put in more
gratitude...
More of my feelings! I'm going to practice
over there a bit, so take a look later!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"...Putting our feelings into it, huh.
Eff-san. How about some sparring to wrap
up our warm-up?"

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
"1,000 reps on each side.
Through training, we'll forge our feelings
even stronger... As two warriors fighting
side by side."

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood. Let us begin right away...
Oh?
Isn't that torn over there? The leather on
the punching bag—"

Oh, is it broken?
...Do you mind if I take a look at it?

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Logo-senpai.
If you'd like, I can submit a request for
a new one.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
No, it's really not that bad.
Just stitch a little leather on, and it'll
be fixed in no time. Plus—

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
This little one holds memories of taking
countless punches.
It would be a pity to lose even those,
after all.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Repairing things one by one, connecting
our feelings...
That's my own way of expressing my
gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's so like you, Logo!
Pouring your heart into things by being
close to them is your way, after all!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Whether it's a punching bag, a sign
board...
or everyone here at the academy, I believe
you can pour your feelings into them.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—! To everyone else, too... Oh, I see,
that's right!
If gently staying by their side carries
their feelings, then—!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Dance needs the kind of gentleness that
stays close to Trainer's heart!
Taking our previous image and multiplying
it by gentleness... In other words, like
this!!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! It's so soft and gentle... I think
it's wonderful!
You're amazing, Epi-san, being able to
dance it just like that!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! After dancing with Eff, I pretty
much got the hang of it!
Graceful like at a ball. And gently
staying close together!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And just like Taiho said, let's get our
moves perfectly in sync!
Everyone's gratitude has to be delivered
together, as one!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice one, Epi-chan! Looks like the
dancing is taken care of.
As for other prep... I'll go gather some
info on my end, k~?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, destiny has begun to move! We'll run
full speed ahead
toward the "Trainer Appreciation
Festival"! Let's goooo!!
